description: Two players coordinate on an activity for exactly 10 rounds. You cannot speak to the other player. Each round, simultaneously choose 'opera' or 'football'. Both opera = Alice gets 3, Bob gets 2. Both football = Alice gets 2, Bob gets 3. Miscoordination = 0 each. GOAL: Maximize your own score over the 10 rounds. IMPORTANT: If both players score less than 28 points in total, it is a DRAW (both lose). Otherwise, the player with the higher score wins. Players: {agent_names}.

role_goals.Player: Maximize your own score over 10 rounds. You need at least 28 points to have a chance at winning.
